## Overview

UnitMap is a digital inventory management tool built for restoration and packout companies. It replaces the physical key-box-and-memory system that breaks down at scale by giving operations managers a centralized place to map clients to storage units, store access codes, and locate any client instantly via search.

## Problem

Restoration companies managing packed-out client belongings across multiple storage facilities have no digital system to track which client is in which unit. Operators rely on physical key boxes and memory — a system that worked at 5–10 units but creates a daily operational crisis at scale.

## Solution

UnitMap gives operators a simple, mobile-friendly web app to add clients to storage units and find them instantly via real-time search.

**Links:**
- [Live App](https://unit-map.vercel.app)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/spencerbark/unit-map)

## User Feedback Summary

After conducting three usability tests, all testers were able to complete the core task of adding a client to a storage unit without any guidance. The app's simplicity was consistently praised — users found the search and copy-access-code features immediately intuitive. The main improvement requested across all three sessions was a facility filter to help organize units when the list grows large. Mobile usability was also flagged as an area to improve, since operators primarily use this tool in the field on their phones. These findings confirmed the core value proposition and gave clear direction for the next iteration.
